reviews.title: I Love Lovevery!
reviews.contents: I’ve been in love with this company since 2020 purchasing for my first grandson. Now I have 3 grandchildren and they are thriving with these products. I just started the 28 day app trial and spent 2 hours going through the valuable information for all 3 of my grandchildren (all different age groups) provided by the professional people associated with the company. They truly take the guesswork out of toys and provide instruction/demonstrations on how to successfully use these kits!! It is a win win situation and you cannot go wrong investing in these products especially when it comes to successfully engaging your children through all ages.

reviews.title: Why is EVERYTHING a subscription these days??
reviews.contents: I ordered 4 years of play kits. That’s about $1,920 our one income home has given to this company on our very limited budget. Because I believe in the benefits these toys bring and I value the education their app brought along with them. Another thing I believe in? Sustainability. So we took good care of our kits in order to pass them along to our subsequent children, knowing that the app was still there to help me remember all the great ways we can use these kits, beyond what’s included in the paper play guide. It truly made the whole subscription worth it. Well, around age 4, the play kits weren’t engaging my child the way they used to and we couldn’t justify the $40/month, so I sadly ended the kit subscription. But I still had the app to help me with my younger 2 children. And now, I go to check it out and it’s $12/month?? I mean, I get that it’s a great resource and maybe those who haven’t ordered the play kits should be asked to pay, but I seriously have to pay $12 a month just because I’m not buying all new kits for my younger children? Where’s the sustainability in that? I think it’s ridiculous. $1,920 in toys should buy a lifetime app subscription anyway. I’m just frustrated and disappointed. These were expensive toys to begin with, and they’re choosing to gatekeep the best ways to use them just to make more money.

reviews.title: Love It!
reviews.contents: I love this company and constantly recommend it. My baby has taken to the play kits and the videos on this app add another layer to the guide books that come with it. I love that we can ask the experts questions! I’ve asked two questions so far and it was invaluable. I love that we get to read the Q & A of others but it hasn’t been updated in a few days. I hope it gets updated soon and that my questions get featured too. I’ve heard people say the subscription is expensive but this APP is now part of your subscription and it adds so much to it  that it is worth the investment for sure!

reviews.title: Great Tool for Newbies
reviews.contents: This app is a great tool to use along side the the toys. I love that it gives ideas on how to use the toys with my baby but what I really love is the information on milestones, tips on how to work on milestones and more expert advice. I have found the Q & A section useful as well, it seems other parents are experiencing what I am and the reasoning explained behind specific actions my infant is making is helping me to not feel alone and understand him and what he needs better. Overall, this app is Is helping me to feel more confident.

reviews.title: So many hidden costs
reviews.contents: I subscribed for 9 months and bought many playkits. I like the toys themselves and loved how the app suggests activities and explained each toy in the kit. My disappointment came once I cancelled my subscription. I was expecting to lose access to all the extra info, but was shocked that I was cut off from the explanation and activities for the playkits already purchased. If I want learn about a toy I purchased in the 9 months kit, I cannot, unless I pay for an ongoing subscription. This is awful. I understand that I will not get full access no longer being a subscriber, but surely I should still be able to see what I had already purchased. These kits are very expensive to not include some permanent access to information about the toys I bought.

reviews.title: Toys that are fun to use and quality!
reviews.contents: My baby enjoys everything in his play kits and is developing so well with them! We are on the charmer kit now and I couldn’t wait to open it. This app paired with the kits have been such a life saver when it comes to toys and activities. I love that it helps guide me with milestones and makes me feel good if he hasn’t reached them yet. It gets exhausting thinking of new activities on top of everything else I have to do and this makes it so much easier!

reviews.title: Just what I needed
reviews.contents:
Since my little one was born I’m on the lookout for content that helps me throughout this journey. I used What to expect, but as much as I enjoyed their daily and weekly content throughout my pregnancy, their postpartum content is just not at all personalized and has no real added value neither it is interesting. 

However, Lovevery has just as amazing and valuable content on their new app as their products and courses. Wow! Already loving it!

reviews.title: Wish I had this resource
reviews.contents: When I was a Mother. Now, I’m a grandmother and, well, better late than never when it comes to Lovevery. The learning materials are high quality and spot on in terms of a child’s readiness and development.  The articles on different topics ( just read the one on reading, books, and toddlers) are so thoughtful, smart, and authoritative. Hats off to the people at Lovevery.  Great for parents…wonderful for children.

reviews.title: This app READ MY MIND.
reviews.contents: Being a first time parent is hard, and this app has helped me feel so much more confident. It delivers me information at just the right time for my baby, I’m able to ask childhood development experts questions about my baby’s development and milestones, and I’ve found so many new ways to play with her. I love this app and will recommend it and all of Lovevery’s products to all my new parent friends!

reviews.title: The tools to parent confidently
reviews.contents: Everyone knows that raising kids is hard - and there are (a lot of) moments where you wonder if you are doing it right. That’s where Lovevery steps in. This app and the digital play guide is the perfect compliment to the Play Kits. And on top of that the Expert Q&A, content that is designed specifically for my child’s age, and an overview of the developmental stage of my kiddo all help reassure that I’m on the right track as a parent.
